title: Clade-aware analysis of vertebrate DNMT3L reveals modular constraint and lineage-structured switching-helix residue states
description: Reproducibility archive for a clade-aware analysis of vertebrate DNMT3L sequence evolution. The archive contains source and filtered alignments, selection-model inputs and outputs, inferred and taxonomy-constrained trees, saturation and structural-context analyses, machine-readable summaries, figures, supplementary tables, software records, scripts, provenance notes, manifests, and checksums. The manuscript itself is not distributed in this archive.
